column1: # Custom 4 MB partition table for Heltec V2 KNOCK-OFFs that ship with 4 MB
# Winbond flash instead of the genuine 8 MB. Layout uses TWO OTA slots
# (no factory) so OTA can cycle indefinitely between ota_0 and ota_1.
# V2.3.16-pre3 change: dropped the factory partition. Pre-V2.3.16 layout had
# factory + ota_0 only (1.875 MB each). That worked for the FIRST OTA
# (factory → ota_0) but failed on the SECOND OTA: now running from ota_0
# no other OTA slot to write to → ESP_ERR_OTA_PARTITION_CONFLICT.
# (esp_ota_get_next_update_partition returns the only OTA partition
# is the running one; esp_ota_begin then refuses with the conflict error.)
# Solution: replace factory + ota_0 with ota_0 + ota_1
# (1.875 MB each
column2: app slots span 0x20000..0x3E0000 of the 4 MB chip)

column1: # now esp_ota cycles ota_0 ↔ ota_1 forever like the genuine 8 MB layout.
# Boot sequence with no factory:
#   - Bootloader checks otadata partition.
#   - On first cable-flash
#     this as "no OTA selected" and defaults to ota_0 (first OTA partition).
#   - After first OTA: otadata points at ota_1 (or whichever was just
#     written)
column2: bootloader picks that on subsequent boots.

column1: # Trade-off vs the 8 MB layout: no factory recovery image. If both ota_0
